_about: Limits for the real style by day, for tools/look.mjs --check (npm run check:real): the sky is blue, the shadows are deep, the car sits on the road and what is lit is not white. A rule: { shot, metric, min, max }. card is the card shot (tools/look.mjs, SHOTS): a grey card and a white ball by the road.
